name: Eon Rush
description:
About This Game

Eon Rush is a session-based co-op Action RPG for 1-4 players. Real teamwork. Endgame-level combat from match one.
Built for MOBA and ARPG fans looking for fresh challenges.

No 100-hour grind to get to an endgame.

No level-gap lockouts.

No “sorry, you’re too low level to play with us.”

Jump in. Choose Eon Stone powerups. Trigger devastating Fusions. Finish a full run in 15-20 minutes.

PLAY TOGETHER. ALWAYS.

Most ARPGs split friends apart. Level 20 can't queue with level 70. Someone always has to catch up.

Not here. Progression enhances your options, not your access. New players and veterans squad up instantly. Skill and coordination matter more than hours logged.

REAL CO-OP. NOT STAT AURAS.

Abilities interact through the Fusion system. Freeze + Shock. Burn + Heavy Impact. Marked targets detonating at the perfect moment.

This isn't "stand near ally for +5% damage." It's coordinated combo windows, battlefield-wide chain reactions, and run-defining team synergy.

EVERY RUN BUILDS DIFFERENTLY

Discover Eon Stones during each expedition: run-based upgrades that reshape your abilities. Modify skills. Amplify status interactions. Unlock new Fusion paths.

Earlier choices shape later options. No two runs feel the same.

SHORT SESSIONS. FULL ARC.

Each mission escalates through structured combat phases, optional high-risk objectives, mini-bosses, multi-phase boss fights, and competitive 2v2 PvP arenas.

Win or lose, you finish a complete arc in one focused session. No 45-minute doomed matches. No filler.

PROGRESSION WITHOUT THE GRIND

Between runs, unlock permanent loadouts, Guardian Vault upgrades, and Tactical Calldown abilities.

You don't grind to reach the real game. You're already playing it.
short_desc: Eon Rush is a co-op ARPG with 20-minute competitive runs. Evolve your build mid-run, unleash decisive power spikes, and chain synergies to climb global leaderboards. No 100-hour grind required. Master Heroes from across the Eras and conquer brutal gauntlets and colossal bosses together.
